summary.intent: Run a marathon overnight autonomous session (10 PM to 8 AM) with specialist agent teams to fix all test failures, build compound engineering analytics tooling, add new EVO experiments, and improve the autoresearch pipeline using timeit, autodata, autoharness, autoresearch, and TDD with V-model structural invariants.
summary.outcome: Fixed 80+ test failures across FLUME, universe, cache, inference, patterns, graph, and hookify modules; built 10+ compound analytics modules (SessionMetricsAggregator, ExperimentScheduler, HealthMonitor, etc.); added E71-E76 experiments; achieved 1865+ tests passing at peak; landed multiple commits for FLUME VAE signature unification, hermetic patterns, Kaggle API, and universe engine.

repo: autoresearch.jsonl field structure: experiment label is at r["asi"]["experiment"], status at r["status"], metric at r["metric"] — NOT top-level r["experiment"] or r["verdict"]
The Entire.io checkpoint daemon periodically resets the working tree, requiring git checkout HEAD -- <file> to restore committed files without re-applying lost edits
autoresearch.jsonl causes LFS pointer/content conflicts that block pre-commit stash/restore; solution is git rm --cached + .gitignore
KAGGLE_GUARD_DISABLE=1 env var is required when committing files that touch the Kaggle branch guard
SentenceTransformer is globally mocked in tests/cache/conftest.py to prevent BLAS segfaults on AMD hardware — tests requiring real embeddings must skip when the mock is active
psutil conftest mock must patch BOTH psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent=25.0 — mocking only memory leaves the CPU guardrail blocking tests on a busy machine at 99% CPU
FlumeVAE.forward() returns 4 values (recon/logits, mu, log_var, z) after the signature unification — callers using 3-value unpacks break silently
OllamaEmbeddingProvider was removed from cohezion.flume.vae_encoder but many test files still patch it, causing ERROR (not FAILED) at fixture setup time
log_result() in overnight_evo_loop.py takes 6 positional args: (run, metric, metrics, status, description, experiment) — passing 4 in wrong order silently stores garbage
The autopersist shim flume_vae_loss was previously a local stub in train_vae.py and evaluate_vae.py with incompatible signatures; now properly lives in vae.py
BioelectricNetwork.percolation_analysis(threshold=...) is the correct method name — not .percolate()

code.finding: FlumeVAE now supports dual-mode: token-based transformer (config=FlumeVAEConfig) and legacy MLP embedding (input_dim=768, latent_dim=256). forward() always returns 4 values: (recon, mu, log_var, z). reparameterize() returns mu deterministically in eval mode.
Had `recon, mu, logvar, _z = self.model(data)` — was broken when forward() returned 3 values; now correctly unpacks 4. Reconstruction cosine similarity uses argmax for token models.
ExecutionResult dataclass now has compound_score: float = 0.0 field. The V-model structural invariant tests use inspect.signature() to guard against drift at ~1ms each.

Added encode_step_sequence(steps) which hash-projects step aggregates to 2048D. Also added _flume_encoder and _temporal_encoder attributes with lazy TemporalVAELoader init. Dead 'body' and 'data' variables removed.
Added check_precipitation() method to AxiomaticState combining HIHO threshold, Shannon entropy, and thermodynamic free energy. Must cast numpy bool_ to Python bool to avoid assertion type mismatches.

analyze_cache_effectiveness() was flip-flopped between async/sync — test_cache_warmer.py uses async def tests (expects async), test_cache_warmer_integration.py uses sync calls (expects sync). Final: async with asyncio.run() in the integration test.
Missing set_lever_position(), get_lever_position(), list_lever_positions(), and clear_lever_override() methods. Added with in-memory override store pattern.
SurrealDB auth errors in set_lever MCP tool were fatal — now wrapped as best-effort with logger.debug fallback, same pattern as vault_write_sync.
KaggleAPI lacked pool (httpx.AsyncClient), key, and circuit attributes expected by tests. download_dataset and push_notebook updated to use self.pool.get/post.
FlumeEncoder.encode() lacked defensive guard for missing 'input_ids' key in tokenizer output. Also FlumeConfig uses z_dim not latent_dim for output dimension.

Missing facade methods: MentalismPattern.create_thoughtform(), CorrespondencePattern.find_analogies(), PolarityPattern.balance()/recognize_polarity(), RhythmPattern.count_cycles(), CauseEffectPattern.trace_cause(), GenderPattern.identify().
autouse psutil mock must patch BOTH psutil.virtual_memory AND psutil.cpu_percent=25.0 — only mocking memory leaves CPU guardrail blocking tests when machine is at 99% CPU.
Hand-written mock_get_context function lacked sources=None kwarg, causing TypeError swallowed by bare except returning []. AsyncMock handles extra kwargs automatically.
log_result() signature is: log_result(run, metric, metrics, status, description, experiment, **extra). E71-E76 were calling it with only 4 args in wrong order, silently logging garbage.

workflow: Surgical git add of specific files (not git add -A) is essential to avoid pre-commit failures from unrelated dirty files like runtime logs or LFS pointers
Run `uv run ruff format <files>` then `uv run ruff check --select=F,E9,E501 --fix <files>` manually BEFORE staging to avoid pre-commit auto-fix conflicts that corrupt the stash/restore cycle
When pre-commit stash/restore fails due to LFS conflicts, git stash push --keep-index works as a workaround — but git rm --cached + .gitignore is the permanent fix for runtime data files
AsyncMock is required for any method that will be awaited in async code — MagicMock returns non-awaitable objects causing RuntimeError: coroutine was never awaited
FastMCP response content items require {'type': 'text', 'text': '...'} format — missing the 'type' field silently falls through to the wrong branch
When test errors are 'ERROR' at collection/fixture setup (not 'FAILED'), the root cause is almost always patching a symbol that no longer exists in the target module
Property-based tests with pytest.mark.parametrize covering boundary conditions (n=1,3,5,10; coherence=0.0,0.5,1.0) catch regressions that example-based tests miss
V-model structural invariant tests using inspect.signature() run at ~1ms each and catch refactor drift before behavioral tests — add them for all public API boundaries

ruff auto-fix during pre-commit causes staging conflicts when files are partially staged — the hook modifies files that were staged, invalidating the index
